players.product: NVLink copper cable cartridges, high-speed connectors and cable assemblies for NVL72 racks

quarterly_data.signal: Communications infrastructure equipment (annual report): the company says it has won the main global telecom-equipment makers as customers and its 5G network equipment is moving to 5G-A in large-volume delivery; in parallel it is expanding communications customers in vertical industries, has completed development and trial production of a new project, and expects that project to enter its mass-production ramp in 2026 and reach stable volume supply in 2027-2028; its microwave backhaul products achieved a breakthrough.
quarterly_data.figure: new vertical-industry communications project: mass-production ramp expected in 2026, stable volume supply in 2027-2028
